podcast.title: Passing in 2022
podcast.body: Margo Netts passed away in 2022 at the age of 84, marking the end of a long and impactful career in the music industry, leaving behind a legacy of contributions to artist development and label management. "She died in 2022 at the age of 84."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Campaigns for Major Artists
podcast.body: During her tenure as an executive, Margo Netts was instrumental in working on marketing and promotional campaigns for a wide array of prominent artists, including Stevie Nicks, Pete Townshend, ABBA, and Hall & Oates. Her influence helped shape the careers of many popular acts. "She worked on campaigns for everyone from Stevie Nicks to Pete Townsend to Abba to Holland Oats."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Long Career as Music Executive
podcast.body: Margo Netts entered the music business as an executive in 1970, demonstrating her early involvement in the industry. She later took on a leadership role, running Atco Records for most of the 1980s, overseeing its operations and artistic direction. "She later ran at co-records for most of the 80s."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
